faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post is 22nd October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 1400 - 1800 Per Hour, depending on the qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the BMC post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is an MBBS degree with at least 2 years of experience. A PG in General Medicine is preferred.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this RBI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Interview and a Medical Test.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location is Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. Does RBI offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q10. How should I submit my application?
faq.answer: You need to send the completed application form along with required documents to the official address mentioned in the notification via Speed Post or Registered Post.
